taskGoal: Add a --json flag to the status command so agent hosts can consume stable output.

changedFiles.changeSummary: Added status --json parsing and JSON rendering path.
Added acceptance coverage for status --json output.

decisions: Keep text status output as the default renderer.
Use JSON only when --json is explicitly supplied.
nextActions: Inspect the recorded test gate evidence before claiming done.
Run status --json once if the event log does not contain a fresh passing test gate.
doNotRepeat: Do not re-scan unrelated packages before checking the changed files and gate evidence.
